_readme: Hand-curated 'firsts' and milestones keyed by ISO3. 'wiki' is the English Wikipedia title (used for live profiles and photos). Every country also gets automatic firsts derived from Wikidata office-holder records. Add a country by copying the IND block.

firsts.title: First Deputy Prime Minister & Home Minister
firsts.name: Vallabhbhai Patel

firsts.title: First Governor-General of independent India
firsts.name: Lord Mountbatten
firsts.wiki: Louis Mountbatten, 1st Earl Mountbatten of Burma

firsts.title: First Law Minister; chaired the Constitution Drafting Committee
firsts.name: B. R. Ambedkar

firsts.title: First Finance Minister; presented the first Union Budget (26 Nov 1947)
firsts.name: R. K. Shanmukham Chetty

firsts.title: Constitution adopted by the Constituent Assembly
firsts.name: Constitution of India

firsts.title: First Speaker of the Lok Sabha
firsts.name: G. V. Mavalankar

firsts.title: First Indian to join the Indian Civil Service (ICS)
firsts.name: Satyendranath Tagore

firsts.title: First Indian Commander-in-Chief of the Army
firsts.name: K. M. Cariappa

firsts.title: First woman Governor of a state
firsts.name: Sarojini Naidu

firsts.title: First woman Speaker of the Lok Sabha
firsts.name: Meira Kumar

milestones.title: Independence and Partition
milestones.text: British rule ends; British India is partitioned into the dominions of India and Pakistan.

milestones.title: India becomes a republic
milestones.text: The Constitution comes into force; Rajendra Prasad becomes the first President.

milestones.title: First general election
milestones.text: The world's largest democratic exercise at the time, held over 1951–52.

milestones.title: States reorganised on linguistic lines
milestones.text: The States Reorganisation Act redraws state boundaries.

milestones.title: Sino-Indian War
milestones.text: Border war with China.

milestones.title: Indo-Pakistani War of 1965
milestones.text: Ends with the Tashkent Declaration in January 1966.

milestones.title: Bank nationalisation
milestones.text: Fourteen major commercial banks are nationalised.

milestones.title: 1971 war and creation of Bangladesh
milestones.text: Pakistan's eastern wing becomes independent Bangladesh.

milestones.title: First nuclear test (Smiling Buddha)
milestones.text: India conducts its first nuclear test at Pokhran.

milestones.title: The Emergency (1975–77)
milestones.text: A 21-month state of emergency suspends elections and civil liberties.

milestones.title: First non-Congress government
milestones.text: The Janata Party wins; Morarji Desai becomes Prime Minister.

milestones.title: Assassination of Indira Gandhi
milestones.text: Rajiv Gandhi becomes Prime Minister.

milestones.title: Economic liberalisation
milestones.text: Narasimha Rao's government and Finance Minister Manmohan Singh open up the economy.

milestones.title: Pokhran-II nuclear tests
milestones.text: India declares itself a nuclear-weapon state.

milestones.title: Right to Information Act
milestones.text: Citizens gain a legal right to request government information.

milestones.title: Narendra Modi becomes Prime Minister
milestones.text: First single-party majority in the Lok Sabha since 1984.

milestones.title: Goods and Services Tax (GST)
milestones.text: A nationwide indirect tax replaces many central and state levies.

milestones.title: Article 370 revoked
milestones.text: The special status of Jammu and Kashmir ends.
milestones.wiki: Revocation of the special status of Jammu and Kashmir

milestones.title: Chandrayaan-3 lands near the lunar south pole
milestones.text: India becomes the first country to land near the Moon's south pole.

firsts.title: First African American Supreme Court Justice
firsts.name: Thurgood Marshall

firsts.title: First woman Speaker of the House
firsts.name: Nancy Pelosi

milestones.title: Independence declared
milestones.text: Thirteen colonies declare independence from Great Britain.

milestones.title: Constitution in force
milestones.text: The federal government under the Constitution begins operating.

milestones.title: Slavery abolished
milestones.text: The 13th Amendment is ratified after the Civil War.
milestones.wiki: Thirteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution

milestones.title: Women's suffrage
milestones.text: The 19th Amendment guarantees women the right to vote.
milestones.wiki: Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution

milestones.title: Civil Rights Act
milestones.text: Outlaws discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex or national origin.

firsts.title: First woman to take her seat as an MP
firsts.name: Nancy Astor

firsts.title: First British Asian and Hindu Prime Minister
firsts.name: Rishi Sunak

milestones.title: Magna Carta
milestones.text: Limits royal power; a foundation of constitutional law.

milestones.title: Acts of Union
milestones.text: England and Scotland unite as the Kingdom of Great Britain.

milestones.title: Great Reform Act
milestones.text: Expands the electorate and reforms constituencies.

milestones.title: Equal suffrage
milestones.text: Women gain the vote on equal terms with men.
milestones.wiki: Representation of the People (Equal Franchise) Act 1928

milestones.title: Brexit
milestones.text: The UK leaves the European Union.
